cut: Doodle 5, VIRAL CUT v1 (23 Oct) — owner: 'Doodle 5 is now becoming more of bigger news so we should highlight that and make it a viral video'. Hook first, escalate (before the assessment → a police inquiry → headlines in six languages), punch, loop. The v1 draft (papercut/count-the-trees) is unchanged.
argument: About 250,000 trees, by the Guardian's estimate, were cleared for Doodle's Muhos data centre before the required assessment. Police opened a preliminary inquiry; it made headlines worldwide. Felled: about 330 hectares. Planting planned: 130.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.ja: 約25万本の 木が / [消えた]。

captions.source: The Guardian's investigation, 22 Oct 2026: an estimated 250,000 trees felled at Muhos (about 330 ha), as reported by follow-ups (Tom's Guide; Yahoo News; Timberbiz; Common Dreams headline). The original cannot be opened from this session; the clipping on screen credits it as the Guardian's estimate. Re-checked 23 Oct (plan/films/25b-count-the-trees-viral.md).

text.ja: 義務づけられた / [環境影響評価] の / 前に 伐採。

captions.source: LVV (Finland's licensing and supervisory agency), 6 Oct 2026: preparatory work at Muhos and Kajaani to stop until the environmental impact assessments are done, by 23 Oct at the latest (AFP; Al Jazeera 7 Oct; ORF; Euronews). Doodle says it stopped on receiving the letters on 6 Oct.

text.ja: 警察が / [予備調査] を 開始。

captions.source: Oulu police have opened a preliminary inquiry (esiselvitys) into the preparatory work at Muhos, to establish whether there is reason to suspect a crime such as environmental damage; it followed a request filed by a private person on 2 Oct, and two requests in all. Iltalehti, as carried by Kaleva ('IL: Poliisi on aloittanut esiselvityksen Googlen Muhoksen datakeskuksen valmistelutöistä') and MTV Uutiset; Yle; Kaleva ('Oulun poliisille on tehty kaksi tutkintapyyntöä'). An esiselvitys is not a criminal investigation, and the film does not call it one.

text.ja: ニュースは / [世界中] に。

captions.source: Coverage in at least six languages, 7–23 Oct 2026; each slip is a phrase as reported, with no masthead or outlet name: PT '250 mil árvores' (Amazonas Atual), RO 'sute de mii de copaci' (G4Media; GoNews), FI 'metsähakkuut Muhoksella' (Kaleva), DE '500 Fußballfelder Wald' (Pasquale Pillitteri, German edition), ES 'choca con un bosque' (Xataka), EN '250,000 trees' (Tom's Guide and others).

text.ja: 伐採： 約330ha。 / 植樹の 計画： / [130ha]。

captions.source: About 330 ha cleared at Muhos (the figure reported as Tuike Finland's own; the regulator says over 300). 130 ha: Doodle's own statement (AFP, about 7 Oct): its landscaping and biodiversity plans include tree planting across 130 hectares at Muhos. The sapling patch is drawn at 40 % of the clearing.

post.en: About 250,000 trees, by the Guardian's estimate, cleared at Muhos, Finland, for a Doodle data centre, before the required environmental assessment. Police have opened a preliminary inquiry. Planting planned: 130 of ~330 hectares. Who counts the trees? #Finland #AI
post.fi: Noin 250 000 puuta The Guardianin arvion mukaan: Muhoksella hakattiin Doodlen datakeskukselle ennen lain vaatimaa ympäristöarviointia. Poliisi aloitti esiselvityksen. Istutus suunnitteilla: 130 hehtaaria noin 330:sta. Kuka laskee puut?
post.ja: ガーディアン紙の推定で約25万本。フィンランド・ムホスで、Doodleのデータセンターのため、義務づけられた環境影響評価の前に森が伐採された。警察が予備調査を開始。植樹の計画は約330ヘクタールのうち130。木は誰が数える？
